name: update_goal
description: Update the current goal. Call get_goal first for goal_id and revision.

goal_id.description: The exact goal_id returned by get_goal.

revision.description: The exact revision returned by get_goal (positive integer).

objective.description: The replacement goal text; only valid with action=edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: The replacement round cap; only valid with action=edit.

blocked_reason.description: The concrete blocking condition; required when action=blocked.
